source_grounded_contract.capture_error: ScrapeView error card shows Reload page and Try again only for recoverable errors; restricted URL has no recovery actions and Dismiss remains. Try again calls captureActiveTab with activeMode, then lastModeRef, then fast. lastModeRef is set before both Capture and Scroll & capture.
source_grounded_contract.save: A successful save lands a Source and opens the optional filing panel. A refused/unreachable save remains in chrome.storage.local; the Unsaved card owns Retry for a held canonical URL and suppresses the competing ordinary Save. Queue is removed only after confirmed landing.
source_grounded_contract.recognition_role: Guest short-circuits Source lookup (no DB lookup); T26 must be N/A for guest, contrary to its current modes [guest, member, admin]. Signed-in recognition reads all RLS-visible organizations independent of selected org; the explicitly selected organization remains the destination for writes.
source_grounded_contract.filing: FileSourcePanel appears only after landing; Close performs no attachment write. Library is a select including No Library; target chips are staged and removable; filing submits only when at least one target or Library is selected.

executable_next_cases.procedure_quality: The current procedure is not yet executable for the missing natural branches: no reproducible stimulus or exact stale-tab setup is specified, and restricted-page evidence does not prove recoverable UI. Source supplies one real-browser recoverable path: an already-open HTTP(S) tab without the content script yields no-receiver; deep mode is retained for Try again.
procedure: Use an owned ordinary HTTP(S) fixture, open it before reloading the exact unpacked extension so the tab lacks the newly loaded content script, then from Scrape request Scroll & capture. First assert a recoverable no-receiver card with Reload page, Try again, and Dismiss; capture the card, title/description, URL and error class from observed UI/diagnostic state.

In an independent fresh stale-tab setup, click Try again and observe Scrolling/progress, proving deep retry mode; expect the same no-receiver until page reload, then click Reload page in a separate setup, wait for completed navigation, manually retry deep capture, and assert lazy content. Dismiss in another fresh recoverable state and confirm card clears.
For the nonrecoverable branch, retain a restricted URL only as the already-covered Dismiss control check; assert no Reload page/Try again. Do not treat it as a recoverable failure.
executable_next_cases.role_applicability: Capture failure mechanics are auth-independent, but the requested role cells still need at least one observed recovery/dismiss run per guest/member/admin unless the acceptance owner explicitly scopes one shared role-independent result. Keep mode evidence distinct.
executable_next_cases.limits: This is a genuine Chrome content-script lifecycle failure induced by reloading the extension with the fixture tab left open, not a fabricated CaptureError. It does not cover no-host-permission or arbitrary pipeline failures.
